parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description:
The file system ID.

- CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, for example, cpfs-125487\*\*\*\*.

- CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, for example, bmcpfs-0015\*\*\*\*.
